g.text: Market Desk | import, compare, save, reopen (J01-J08)
Repository and transaction-manager calls are folded into H2.
redirect; prior catalogue and list kept
History recording runs only after the replacement has committed.
A recording failure is reported, never rolls back the accepted data
(the accepted import stays and history retries on the next import).
insert one observation per priced pair
read observations and rules; save new events
Record price and show an alert
in-app alerts; closed-app periods are not delivered alerts
fetch exact product and retailer data
exact product; offers are not calculated
Stop and restart the app. Reuse the H2 file;
read saved items and current prices
Explicit retailer choice persists; unavailable prices remain unknown.
Reuses J04 rules: quantity 1..999 and the existing-item/
other-retailer conflict. It does not change reminder state (D07).
